mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (as of the latest monthly data) is associated with more negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the market prices in an imminent tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is greater than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 240 (as of the latest monthly data) signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240, or Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 20-day SPX returns is greater than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of INDPRO above 105 and UNRATE below 4.5 signals an overheating economy that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105 and UNRATE < 4.5, or Rank IC between the product of INDPRO and UNRATE and 20-day SPX returns is greater than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), strong retail sales (RSAFS above 450,000) signal resilient consumer demand that offsets rate hike pressures, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and RSAFS > 450,000, or Rank IC between RSAFS and 20-day SPX returns in monetary tightening cycles is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE below 4.0 (as of the latest monthly data) signals a tight labor market that fuels wage growth and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0, or Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day SPX returns is greater than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST above 1200 (thousands of units) signals a strong housing market that indicates robust consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO above 105 (as of the latest monthly data) signals strong industrial activity that indicates a robust economy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105, or Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), a higher federal funds rate (as of the latest data) signals an imminent rate hike that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 5-day SPX returns in monetary tightening cycles is greater than -0.03.
